membership_inheritance.rule: Generation 2 proposes to inherit generation-1 candidate membership byte-for-byte because the repair changes only the task-specific consequence predicate. Any later candidate-membership change requires a different successor proposal.

task_invariant.name: TASK_ORGANISATIONAL_SIGNATURE_V0_1
explicit_exclusions: track_id, seq, track_age, depth_age and price-component coordinates
viability scalar and other post-hoc/non-task numeric scores
task_invariant.equality_rule: PRESERVED iff anchor and horizon task signatures are both evaluable and exactly equal after canonical projection; otherwise exact inequality is RECONFIGURED.
task_invariant.missingness_rule: Source break is CENSORED. Gamma statuses AVAILABLE/NONE/SOURCE_BREAK are comparable typed states; Z AVAILABLE/NOT_ESTABLISHED are comparable typed states; S must be AVAILABLE with a valid candidate list; Phi AVAILABLE/NOT_EVALUABLE are comparable typed states. Any other required-component state is NOT_EVALUABLE, never coerced to preserved or reconfigured.
task_invariant.horizon_sampling: Retain frozen R3 rule: at H in {4,8,16,32} observed bars, use the last lawful current-segment returned observer state available as-of the horizon bar; source break/release end/insufficient future bars censor.

decision_surface_unchanged.primary_effect: fraction TASK_INVARIANT_PRESERVED_AT_H in NON_MATCH minus same fraction in MATCH
decision_surface_unchanged.support_floor: each binary class >=32 evaluable origins and >=4 source segments
